name: The Fathomless
summary: A pact with a power of the deep sea.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.short: Water and storm spells join your warlock list.
features.summary: The Fathomless adds these spells to the warlock spell list for you; learn them like other warlock spells.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.short: Bonus action: summon a tentacle that lashes for 1d8 cold.
features.summary: As a bonus action, summon a 10 ft. spectral tentacle within 60 ft. for 1 minute. When you summon it and as a bonus action later, it makes a melee spell attack: 1d8 cold damage (2d8 at 10th) and the target's speed drops by 10 ft. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.summary: You gain a swimming speed of 40 ft. and can breathe underwater.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.short: Resist cold; talk to anything underwater.
features.summary: You gain resistance to cold damage. While fully submerged, any creature also submerged can understand your speech and you can understand theirs.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.short: Reaction: your tentacle reduces damage to an ally.
features.summary: When you or a creature within 10 ft. of your tentacle takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce it by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th).

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.short: Cast Evard's Black Tentacles once for free; damage can't break your concentration.
features.summary: You learn Evard's Black Tentacles; it counts as a warlock spell and doesn't count against spells known. Once per long rest you can cast it without a slot, gaining temporary hit points equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break your concentration on it.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.short: Teleport yourself and allies to a body of water within 1 mile.
features.summary: As an action, you and up to five willing creatures within 30 ft. teleport to a body of water you have seen within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.
